resources.string: Wispr by Deepu Gupta uses this to notice when a keyboard is open, show the mic bubble, and type your spoken words into the text box you picked (it only adds text, never deletes). When YOU tap Understand screen, it reads the text on the screen (or takes a screenshot on Android 11+) and sends it over HTTPS to Groq to translate or explain it. It does not read, save or send what you type, and nothing is sent unless you ask. Your voice recordings go only to Groq, with your own key.
Mic bubble over every keyboard, mini AI window and one-tap Understand screen
